# `loans.personal_loan.LoanSettled`

The loan is fully amortized and settled (terminal): the outstanding balance reached zero through the final scheduled installment or a full early repayment. The closed-end-asset analogue of term_deposit.DepositMatured. Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers. No PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2).

## Payload fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `total_capital_repaid_cents` | `long` | Total capital returned over the loan's life (= the original principal) as integer EUR cents. |
| `total_interest_paid_cents` | `long` | Total interest paid over the loan's life as integer EUR cents. |
| `settled_on` | `int` (`date`) | The settlement date as days since epoch. |

## Governing ADRs

[ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md), [ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md)
